content:
ava: Quick sync — post-launch numbers are in, and there's a small attribution delta we should triage from the webinar traffic yesterday.

carlos: Seen the spike on the acquisition dashboard. Looks like direct + referral both jumped around 11:30 PST. Possible UTM mismatch? :thinking_face:

priya: I pulled the landing page logs and the UTM tags look ok for the paid channels. Organic socials have inconsistent utm_source values tho — sometimes 'redwood' vs 'Redwood'.

dylan: Oof. Case-sensitive UTMs again. Can we standardize before next campaign? Also webinar signups show a higher drop-off after the registration page.

ava: Good catch. Can someone post the small query that generated the dashboard numbers? Need to confirm the mapping between 'source' in GA and our CRM routing rules.

sam-analytics: Putting the SQL here: ```sql
SELECT source, COUNT(*) as leads
FROM events.webinar_registrations
WHERE event_date = '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY leads DESC;
```

sam-analytics: Raw numbers: direct 412, twitter 128, linkedin 93, partner-referral 74, organic 45. But CRM shows 520 leads for the same window. There's ~ -20% variance.

priya: CRM ingestion lag? We had the backend retry job fail for ~15 minutes during that window (see infra-alert). Could explain mismatch. @dylan can you confirm?

marketing-bot: deploy-bot: Alert — retry-service restarted at 2026-03-20T11:40:12Z (incident 2026-03-20-08).

dylan: Yep, saw the restart. Some webhook POSTs were delayed; retries filled in later and appear in CRM but not in the event stream snapshot we used for the dashboard.

carlos: That explains CRM > dashboard. For attribution delta, though, there's another small class of sessions where utm_campaign is missing but we had UTM in email links — email provider might have stripped params when redirecting.

ava: Two action items: (1) canonicalize UTM parsing in the tracking lib (add case-insensitive normalizer + fallback mapping). (2) Recompute the dashboard with full-event replay to include delayed webhook events and compare. Who owns each?

priya: I'll take (1) — will open PR and patch the tracker on staging by EOD.

sam-analytics: I'll handle (2) — running an ETL replay now. ETA ~45m. Will post diff when done.

dylan: While we're at it, can we add a quick dashboard widget for 'webinar funnel latency' (time from reg to CRM ingestion) so this doesn't surprise us again? Low-effort panel.

ava: Yes please. Add as a separate card in the weekly KPI dashboard. Tag it 'data-latency'.

carlos: One more ask from growth: the benchmark narrative for the post-launch newsletter — can we include adjusted numbers (post-replay) and a short note about attribution caveats? They want something for the Monday exec email.

priya: I'll update the messaging: include both raw and adjusted leads, note the retry window + UTM normalization plan. Draft in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/launch-postmortem (shareable).

sam-analytics: Replay finished — adjusted totals: direct 430, twitter 130, linkedin 95, partner-referral 78, organic 50. Total adjusted leads = 783 (matches CRM within 2%). Diff attached in the dashboard diff panel.

ava: Great — that delta is acceptable. Carlos, can you finalize the benchmark language and share with @growth for the exec email by COB? Also add the 'data-latency' bullet in the KPI notes.

carlos: On it. Will drop the blurb and the updated slide in #marketing-assets by 17:30 PT.

priya: PR for tracking normalizer created: https://git.internal/redwood/track/merge/234 — includes unit tests and a migration to lowercase utm parsing.

dylan: Quick thought: for next webinar, let's add a hidden query param from the registration widget that we use as canonical source internally (no reliance on external UTM cleanliness). Low friction and predictable.

ava: Love that. Priya, include that change in the tracker PR or a follow-up?

priya: I'll include it in a follow-up but will coordinate with frontend so the widget emits `rw_source=webinar_reg_v3`.

marketing-bot: calendar-bot: Note — follow-up webinar retrospective scheduled 2026-03-23 10:00 PT.

ava: Thanks everyone. Final checklist: PR merged for normalizer, ETL replay results posted (sam), exec blurb sent (carlos), dashboard widget added (dylan). If all green, we'll close the loop tomorrow in the retrospective. :white_check_mark:
